project_type: Python async web crawler (MediaCrawler) with CloakBrowser stealth browser integration
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, unittest.mock for mocking. Tests in tests/ directory with conftest.py fixtures.
build_command: pip install -e . or pip install -r requirements.txt
verification_instructions: Run pytest with coverage and confirm all tests pass with 90%+ coverage on stealth-related code
setup_instructions: pip install pytest-cov pytest-asyncio; ensure cloakbrowser is importable
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install any dependencies. No real browser launching needed - all CloakBrowser calls should be mocked.
contribution_requirements: Tests must use pytest and pytest-asyncio. Mock external dependencies. Test file goes in tests/ directory.
key_patterns: Existing tests use @patch decorator for config mocking, pytest fixtures in conftest.py, class-based test organization (TestXhsStoreFactory pattern). Async tests use pytest.mark.asyncio. The project uses 'import config' to access base_config values.
directory_structure: Root: config/ (configuration), base/ (abstract base classes), media_platform/{xhs,douyin,bilibili,kuaishou,weibo,tieba,zhihu}/ (platform crawlers with core.py), tests/ (unit tests), tools/ (utilities), store/ (data storage)
